items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I never saw Jim. I saw him maybe...I was out at the ball park with Mayo, but I never heard him play.

ctx.x: How in the hell he became so famous. And never... I never saw him anyplace. I don't think I ever saw Jim. I saw him maybe...I was out at the ball park with Mayo, but I never heard him play. Now how can things like that happen?
I don't know. He didn't make any records until...
